시편 115:1.content: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.

시편 115:2.content: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

시편 115:3.content: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

시편 115:4.content: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

시편 115:5.content: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

시편 115:6.content: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

시편 115:7.content: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

시편 115:8.content: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

시편 115:9.content: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

시편 115:10.content: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

시편 115:11.content: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

시편 115:12.content: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

시편 115:13.content: He will bless them that fear the Lord, both small and great.

시편 115:14.content: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

시편 115:15.content: Ye are blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.

시편 115:16.content: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

시편 115:17.content: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.

시편 115:18.content: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.
